set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: W01
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend and frontend engineers

Outcome: Curators can create and populate a dataset and researchers can obtain verified full exports through supported product workflows.

Acceptance:
- Expose authorized creation, approved staging intake and/or bounded resumable upload through durable operation contracts, with quotas and source-evidence isolation; reject arbitrary server paths.
- Show scope, findings, progress and supported retry/cancel/resume actions; preserve atomic publication and allow mapping/metadata decisions without database edits.
- Provide durable full-export planning, progress, verified delivery and interruption recovery under current authority; demonstrate complete browser/API journeys on supported native BIDS.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/NativeRepository.scala
- docs/http-api.md

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: W01: Complete authenticated intake and reproducible export workflows
